title: Hardware analysis
description: A device's serial console, by default sandbox-ai's emulated SB-42 sensor node: identify it, read its boot, note bootloader, firmware and flash layout; the agent reaches only its provider and the device.

port.label: Port of the serial console on this host
port.hint: sandbox-ai demo-device start (the emulated one), or ser2net in front of a real device

device.label: A real device to hand over as well

prompt: A device's serial console is reachable at socket://127.0.0.1:{port} (pyserial: serial.serial_for_url, or nc 127.0.0.1 {port}); a device under /dev may have been handed to you as well. Find out what it is without changing it: read its boot messages, log in to its console, note bootloader, kernel, firmware version, hardware revision and flash layout (read-only: md), and write your findings to /work/hardware-report.md. Never write to its flash or run commands that could.
notes: Start the emulated device first: sandbox-ai demo-device start (port 4000); a real one: ser2net on the host.
Podman only (pasta forwards the host's port).
Only the agent's provider is reachable: datasheets come from you (copy them into the workspace).
